headline: CTM Proposes to Sheinbaum Linking Wages to Productivity Ahead of 40-Hour Workweek
summary: After meeting President Claudia Sheinbaum, CTM leader Tereso Medina said the union proposed tying salaries to productivity as Mexico moves toward a 40-hour work week. The alliance also covers health, housing and education.
why: Wage-setting and working-hour rules affect labor costs for Mexican employers, including manufacturers and exporters with large unionized workforces.
original_headline: CTM plantea a Sheinbaum ligar salarios a productividad rumbo a la jornada de 40 horas
